verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents region-specific Voice Agent API endpoints (EU, AU, India) and an EU endpoint for customers who need data processed within the European Union, so users can choose a processing region. The evidence speaks to where data is processed, not explicitly where it is stored at rest, so residency of stored data is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that stored/retained data stays in the chosen region, a full list of supported regions (the India endpoint URL is truncated), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: The Voice Agent API is available on the EU endpoint at wss://api.eu.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse, the AU endpoint at wss://api.au.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse, and the India endpoint
For customers requiring data processing within the European Union, Deepgram provides an EU-specific endpoint at api.eu.deepgram.com.
